msgs.t: Send me your questionnaire before you go to the field.
Monday. And every question should match your objectives.

slides.b: Every question answers one objective. If it doesn't answer any, cut it.
Closed questions and scales up front. Two or three open ones at the very end.
"Is the service fast and friendly?" is two questions. Split it.
Not "How much did the training help you?" Ask "Did the training change how you work?"
Classmates count. Fix every question they had to ask you about.

Tell Toso your topic and objectives. Get the finished questionnaire in Word or PDF.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
